subject: Discovery recap + proposed MAP and procurement timeline for MerchantEdge
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@merchantedge.com>, Susan Lee <susan.lee@merchantedge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed MAP and procurement timeline for MerchantEdge

Alex / Susan —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) proposal so we can align on milestones and owners. High-level notes from the call: 

- Primary goal: Reduce inference cost and tail-latency for transaction enrichment models (avg seq len ~120 tokens).
- Decision criteria: 99th-percentile latency, unit cost per 1k tokens, data residency safeguards, and integration effort for SDK/OBS pipeline.
- Key stakeholders we identified: Alex (product lead / economic sponsor), Susan (legal/security), procurement (ops/PO owner), and an engineering lead to validate integration (tbd).

Attached: redwood-map-template.xlsx (draft MAP) and security-evidence-summary.pdf (SOC2 / data handling excerpts).

Proposed MAP (suggested owners & target dates) — please adapt: 
1) POC kickoff: define success metrics & test dataset — Owner: Ben / MerchantEdge eng — Target: 2026-07-07
2) Security review: questionnaire + evidence exchange — Owner: Susan / Ben — Target: 2026-07-14
3) Procurement: SOW/PO terms + pricing confirmation — Owner: procurement@merchantedge.com / Ben — Target: 2026-07-21
4) Pilot completion & business review: results vs SLOs, go/no-go — Owner: Alex / Ben — Target: 2026-08-11

Immediate asks: 
- Susan: can you confirm which security artifacts you need beyond the SOC2 summary (e.g., encryption KMS details, logging retention policies)?
- Procurement: who should I loop in for formal SOW/PO discussions and what cadence works for you (weekly/biweekly)?
- Alex: are the target dates above realistic for your internal calendar?

I'll update the attached MAP with any edits you send back and move it into the shared Drive folder (link below).

Best,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0194

Attachment: redwood-map-template.xlsx (map draft), security-evidence-summary.pdf (summary of SOC2 + encryption notes)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bMerchantEdge_MAP
From: Alex Moreno <alex@merchantedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Cc: Susan Lee <susan.lee@merchantedge.com>, procurement@merchantedge.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed MAP and procurement timeline for MerchantEdge

Ben —

Appreciate the clear recap. This matches our notes. A couple quick items: 

1) Timeline: the dates look fine but we have an internal all-hands the week of 7/12, so anything that requires exec sign-off is better before 7/15.
2) Security artifacts: Susan, we need encryption architecture (KMS provider + key rotation cadence), retention for logs (90 days min), and a brief on data flow for PII. Ben — can you confirm those are in the security summary?
3) Procurement: please loop in my head of procurement (procurement@merchantedge.com). They prefer to review SOWs in a single doc and like to see milestone-based payment terms.

We'll ask engineering to nominate an integration lead by Friday.

Thanks,
Alex

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed MAP and procurement timeline for MerchantEdge

Thanks Alex — noted on the exec availability. Susan — quick confirmation: the security-evidence-summary.pdf includes KMS provider (AWS KMS) details, key rotation cadence, and a data flow diagram called out on page 3. I can extract the KMS + retention excerpts into a one-page brief if that would help procurement/legal review.

Procurement — Ben (me) + Monica can run the first SOW draft. Suggested commercial structure: milestone payments keyed to POC acceptance and pilot completion. I attached the redwood-map-template.xlsx with milestone payment placeholders filled in — happy to adapt.

Next steps I propose: 
- This week (by Fri 7/02): MerchantEdge to nominate engineering lead; Redwood to share one-pager security brief.
- Week of 7/05: POC kickoff prep call (30 min) to align datasets & success metrics.
- Week of 7/12: Security deep-dive (Susan + Redwood security SME) — target artifacts exchanged.

If that aligns I'll move the MAP into the shared Drive and set up a 30-min POC prep call on 7/06 at 10:00 PT. Does that time work for your eng lead?

Best,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0194

Attachment: redwood-map-template.xlsx (with milestone payments)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed MAP and procurement timeline for MerchantEdge

Ben —

7/06 10:00 PT is fine on our side for the prep call. I'll draft the initial SOW language (milestone acceptance criteria + payment schedule) and drop it in the shared Drive today so procurement has a doc to review. I'll also prep a one-page security brief pulled from the evidence PDF for Susan.

Looping Evelyn here to confirm we have the right SKU and estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted for their expected throughput — Evelyn, can you flag any assumptions we should call out in the SOW?

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed MAP and procurement timeline for MerchantEdge

Monica / Ben —

Quick note: I'll include two pricing scenarios in the Drive SOW draft — Hosted (standard) and Dedicated (reserve pool). Assumptions: peak concurrent QPS ~60, avg token size ~120, and 99th latency target 250ms. If MerchantEdge expects higher peak, we should call that out as an option for burst capacity.

I'll add the estimate table to redwood-map-template.xlsx and flag where procurement should confirm the PO window.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
